title: Coronagraph Watch
text:
🔭 Coronagraph Watch — November 08, 2026

Solar activity has been elevated today, so here’s a look at the Sun’s outer corona.

🔥 Strongest recent flare: M1.7

We're watching the corona today!

Solar imagery shows a prominent dark coronal-hole region alongside several bright active regions, with no clear large outward structure visible in the coronagraph view.

Image: NOAA SWPC — CCOR-2
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
